title: Land after approval: merge main in, re-check, slicer land, ff-merge, optional push, clean up

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Retrospective R5 (docs/review-2026-10-25-relay-retrospective.md). The hand-run landing script ran on all 28 slices with no failure; it is the last hand step between approve and the next wave. adj 162 (landing.in-ork, open; recommended land-after-approve) would supersede landing.v1 (#49), and docs/boundaries.md:17 changes with it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/engine/states.go:321-372` (commit, finish): after commit, merge the base branch in if it moved, `slicer render`, re-run the check command and `slicer check`, `slicer land ID --branch B`, ff-merge, push when the project setting says so, then the confirmed cleanup (git.cleanup-key).
- `internal/registry/registry.go`: a per-project push setting, off by default (proposed name).
- `docs/boundaries.md:17`, `docs/design.md:183-243`, `docs/state.md`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestLandMergesBaseWhenMoved: a temp repo whose base moved gets the merge, render and a green re-check before the ff-merge.
- TestLandStopsOnRedRecheck: a red check after the merge stops before the ff-merge.
- TestLandPushesOnlyWhenSet.
- TestLandCleansUpAfterConfirm.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: adj 162 is decided (land-after-approve) and #49 is superseded. Owner decisions (2026-10-26 session, AskUserQuestion): (1) a merge conflict when merging the base branch in: ork aborts nothing by hand; it runs one implementer fix round with the conflict as the brief, then the check, the gate and back to awaiting approval; if that fails, it stops in Needs you with 'land blocked: merge conflict' and keeps the worktree. (2) The per-project push setting is off by default; the owner turns it on for the ork project after this lands (say how in docs/manual-steps.md; ork does not change the owner's registry itself). (3) Approval counts as the cleanup confirm of adj 152 for a successful landing: approve, land, then git worktree remove and git branch -d (never -D); the approval card says so before approval (S118). Use temp repos and fakes only; no real push in tests. No AI attribution in commits.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./...; go vet; gofmt -l; slicer check; adj lint.
